exposure: Maternal pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity (BMI categories: normal weight, overweight, obese)
cohort: The study included 24,577 women with a singleton pregnancy who delivered in 2009 in Finland and underwent an oral glucose tolerance test.
finding: Maternal overweight and obesity, both independently and in conjunction with gestational diabetes, significantly increased the risk of adverse perinatal outcomes such as macrosomia, caesarean delivery, and neonatal ward treatment, with GDM further amplifying these risks across BMI categories.
mod_finding: The study found an increased risk of caesarean delivery in overweight or obese women, with this risk further amplified when accompanied by GDM.
